capabilities: scan vault for unreferenced image files
delete unused images to Obsidian trash, system trash, or permanently
exclude folders from the cleanup scan
run cleanup via ribbon icon or command palette
show a deletion log of removed images
extras: Docs list planned features still under development, including automatic cleanup on vault load or on an interval.
problem: Notes accumulate orphaned image files that take up vault space with no built-in way to find or remove them.
summary: Cleanup tool that scans vault Markdown files and deletes image files no longer referenced by any note.
